email.password_changed.body:
The password of your Life Pixel account was just changed, and your other sessions were signed out.

If you did not change it, reset your password at once and write to Life Pixel support.
email.password_changed.subject: Your Life Pixel password was changed
email.reset_password.body:
Someone asked to reset the password of your Life Pixel account.

Open this link to choose a new password:
{link}

The link works for one hour. If you did not ask for it, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
email.reset_password.subject: Reset your Life Pixel password
email.verify_email.body:
Welcome to Life Pixel.

Open this link to verify your email address:
{link}

The link works for 7 days. If you did not create a Life Pixel account, ignore this email.
email.verify_email.subject: Verify your Life Pixel email address
